title: Security vulnerability detection in Apex service class
scenario: Review an Apex service class that queries Contacts and returns them to an LWC, with potential SOQL injection and missing FLS validation

issues_present: SOQL injection: String concatenation in WHERE clause without bind variables
No FLS validation before returning contact data

expected_findings.issue: SOQL injection vulnerability
expected_findings.guidance: Use bind variables (:) instead of string concatenation in SOQL WHERE clauses

expected_findings.issue: Missing WITH SECURITY_ENFORCED in SOQL query
expected_findings.guidance: Add WITH SECURITY_ENFORCED or WITH USER_MODE to enforce FLS at query time

expected_findings.issue: Missing 'with sharing' keyword on class
expected_findings.guidance: Add 'public with sharing' to enforce sharing rules

expected_findings.issue: Returned records may contain inaccessible fields
expected_findings.guidance: Use Security.stripInaccessible() to remove fields user cannot access

title: Performance issue detection: SOQL in loop
scenario: Review an Apex batch job that processes records and queries related data inside a loop, violating bulkification principles

expected_findings.issue: SOQL query inside loop (bulkification violation)
expected_findings.guidance: Move SOQL outside loop. Use Map<Id, List<>> to collect related records in single query

expected_findings.issue: Governor limit risk: 100 SOQL query limit will be exceeded
expected_findings.guidance: For 1000+ records, you'll execute 1000+ SOQL queries instead of 1

expected_findings.issue: No error handling in execute() method
expected_findings.guidance: Wrap DML in try-catch-finally and log errors with proper context

expected_findings.issue: Missing DML bulk guard
expected_findings.guidance: Check !recordsToUpdate.isEmpty() before performing DML

title: Architecture review: Trigger logic violation
scenario: Review an Apex trigger with business logic directly in trigger body instead of delegating to handler/service classes

issues_present: Trigger contains business logic (should be logic-free)
Direct SOQL and DML in trigger
No handler or service class delegation

expected_findings.issue: Business logic in trigger body violates architecture pattern
expected_findings.guidance: Triggers must be logic-free. Delegate to handler class extending KC_TriggerHandler

expected_findings.issue: No recursive execution prevention
expected_findings.guidance: Add static Set<Id> processedIds field and check before processing

expected_findings.issue: SOQL/DML directly in trigger context
expected_findings.guidance: Move logic to Service class with testable methods

expected_findings.issue: No Trigger → Handler → Service → Selector layer separation
expected_findings.guidance: Follow established pattern: Trigger delegates to Handler, Handler to Service, Service to Selector

title: LWC best practices review: Template & JavaScript issues
scenario: Review an LWC component with template syntax errors and improper Apex integration patterns

issues_present: Event names with hyphens instead of lowercase
No error handling for Apex callout

expected_findings.issue: Inline ternary operator in template: {record.status === 'Active' ? 'Yes' : 'No'}
expected_findings.guidance: LWC templates do NOT support inline expressions. Create JavaScript getter: get isActive() { return this.record.status === 'Active'; }

expected_findings.issue: @AuraEnabled(cacheable=true) on method that performs DML
expected_findings.guidance: Cacheable methods must be read-only. Remove cacheable=true or move DML to separate imperative method

expected_findings.issue: Event dispatched with hyphenated name: 'record-updated'
expected_findings.guidance: LWC event names must be lowercase only: 'recordupdated'. Parent listens with onrecordupdated={handler}

expected_findings.issue: No error handling for Apex callout
expected_findings.guidance: Wrap imperative Apex calls in try-catch with error message display using ShowToastEvent

expected_findings.issue: Missing loading spinner during async operations
expected_findings.guidance: Add <lightning-spinner> and control with loading state variable during Apex calls

title: Test coverage and quality review
scenario: Review an Apex test class that lacks proper test structure, edge cases, and bulk operation testing

expected_findings.issue: Test coverage 60% is below 75% deployment minimum
expected_findings.guidance: Achieve minimum 75% coverage, target 90%+ for critical business logic

expected_findings.issue: No @TestSetup method for shared test data
expected_findings.guidance: Use @TestSetup to create test data once, shared across all test methods

expected_findings.issue: Missing negative test cases
expected_findings.guidance: Test both positive (happy path) and negative (error) scenarios

expected_findings.issue: No bulk operation testing (200+ records)
expected_findings.guidance: Create test method with 200+ records to validate bulkification and governor limits

expected_findings.issue: Assertions lack descriptive messages
expected_findings.guidance: Add message parameter to assert: Assert.areEqual(expected, actual, 'Should have 5 orders')

title: Deployment readiness check
scenario: Review a deployment package for metadata completeness, permission sets, and rollback readiness

issues_present: No permission set updates for new custom field

expected_findings.issue: Missing -meta.xml file on new Apex class
expected_findings.guidance: All Apex classes need .cls-meta.xml with API version 66.0 and access modifiers

expected_findings.issue: Permission set not updated for new custom field access
expected_findings.guidance: Add new custom field to existing permission sets so users can access it

expected_findings.issue: No rollback plan documented
expected_findings.guidance: Document rollback procedure: destructiveChanges.xml, data restoration steps, testing in sandbox

expected_findings.issue: CI/CD pipeline not configured
expected_findings.guidance: Add GitHub Actions or similar to automate testing and validation on each commit

expected_findings.issue: No database migration script provided
expected_findings.guidance: Document any data modifications needed during deployment (update scripts, data replication)

title: Error handling and logging review
scenario: Review an integration class that handles callouts and DML errors improperly

expected_findings.issue: Empty catch block - exceptions are swallowed
expected_findings.guidance: Never use empty catch blocks. Always log error or rethrow. Use KC_ErrorLog for logging

expected_findings.issue: DML SaveResult not checked for errors
expected_findings.guidance: Use Database.insert(records, false) and check SaveResult.isSuccess() for each record

expected_findings.issue: Sensitive data (API keys, passwords) logged
expected_findings.guidance: Never log sensitive data. Mask API keys, use separate secure storage

expected_findings.issue: Callout has no timeout or error handling
expected_findings.guidance: Add try-catch for timeouts, set appropriate timeouts, implement retry logic

expected_findings.issue: No error context stored (which record failed, why, when)
expected_findings.guidance: Log detailed context: record ID, operation type, error message, stack trace, timestamp

title: Code quality and maintainability review
scenario: Review a utility class with poor naming conventions, large methods, and duplicate code

issues_present: Class name too generic: 'Utils' instead of domain-specific

expected_findings.issue: Generic class name 'Utils' violates naming conventions
expected_findings.guidance: Use domain-specific names: AccountReconciliationHelper, ContactValidationService

expected_findings.issue: Method processData() is 150 lines (>50 line guideline)
expected_findings.guidance: Break large methods into smaller, focused methods (<50 lines each)

expected_findings.issue: Duplicate code: same email validation logic in 3 methods
expected_findings.guidance: Apply DRY principle: Extract duplicate logic to single reusable method

expected_findings.issue: Hardcoded values: MAX_RETRY = 5 scattered in code
expected_findings.guidance: Define constants in Constants class: public static final Integer MAX_RETRY = 5;

expected_findings.issue: Missing JSDoc comments on public methods
expected_findings.guidance: Add class-level and method-level comments explaining purpose and parameters

title: Aura component review with migration guidance
scenario: Review an Aura component that should be migrated to LWC

issues_present: Inline styling instead of SLDS classes

expected_findings.issue: Component is built with Aura (deprecated in favor of LWC)
expected_findings.guidance: Plan migration to LWC. Aura receives limited investment from Salesforce

expected_findings.issue: Missing accessibility attributes (aria-labels, roles)
expected_findings.guidance: Add aria-label, role, tabindex for screen reader accessibility

expected_findings.issue: Using inline styles instead of SLDS classes
expected_findings.guidance: Use Salesforce Lightning Design System (SLDS) classes for consistency

expected_findings.issue: Migration path: Convert to LWC component
expected_findings.guidance: LWC is the future: simpler, faster, better performance. Plan migration in next sprint

title: Governor limits compliance check
scenario: Review a synchronous Apex class that approaches or exceeds governor limits

issues_present: Large string concatenation causing heap issues

expected_findings.issue: 95 SOQL queries, only 5 remaining before hitting 100 limit
expected_findings.guidance: Consolidate queries. For 100+ records, use Queueable or Batch Apex

expected_findings.issue: 140 DML operations, only 10 remaining before limit
expected_findings.guidance: Use Database.insert/update with allOrNone=false for partial success, or use Batch Apex

expected_findings.issue: Large string concatenation in loop causing heap pressure
expected_findings.guidance: Use StringBuilder pattern or List<String> joined with String.join() to avoid heap issues

expected_findings.issue: Synchronous execution not suitable for bulk processing
expected_findings.guidance: Migrate to Queueable (chainable, 1 per txn) or Batch Apex (200 records per chunk)
